messages:
parth: Heads-up 1: GCP Marketplace reviewer asked for the full security evidence bundle. They want SOC report (redacted), pen-test executive summary, KMS/HSM attestation, SAML/SI integration notes, and a retention policy doc. Also asked about FIPS compatibility for our hardware partner nodes. Who can drive?
sarah: I can take SOC2 redaction + questionnaire answers. Will need legal signoff on redaction list. cc @lisa-legal.
mike: I have a FIPS/HSM attestation PDF from infra (fips-attest-2025.pdf). Can presign; need to confirm whether GCP needs FIPS cert numbers included.
jenn: Pen-test: vendor gave full report but partner policy forbids POC sharing. I can produce 1-page exec summary + remediation status. Also include ticket refs.
lisa-legal: For redactions, we should remove customer names, IPs, and contract-specific clauses. We can supply full report under NDA and SFTP gated access.
parth: Good. Also the SI partner needs SAML metadata + SP/IdP contact. @mike can you export the current SAML metadata XML?
mike: Exported metadata: `/saml/metadata/redwood-sp.xml` in secure repo. Will attach presigned link. Command I use: `presign --path /saml/metadata/redwood-sp.xml --ttl 48h --note "GCP partner review"`.
security-bot: Auto: Created artifact artifact-1924001234-gcp-bundle.zip in s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1924001234/. Default presign TTL is 72h.
sarah: Questionnaire Q5: "Do you use customer-dedicated KMS keys?" Draft: "Yes. We support customer-managed KMS keys per-account. Keys are AWS KMS (or cloud provider equivalent) with HSM-backed protection where required." Adding KMS screenshot and key policy snippet.
jenn: Pen-test exec summary (draft): findings summary, risk ratings, remediation tickets (ENG-908, INFRA-412), and timeline. Not sharing exploit code.
lisa-legal: Confirming: provide redacted SOC + exec summary + attestation PDF + SAML metadata + retention policy. Add a short cover email stating what is redacted and how to request full artifacts under NDA.
parth: FIPS note from hardware partner: they requested NIST SP 800-140 level info and FIPS 140-2 module IDs for our HSM. @mike can you pull module IDs and certs?
mike: Will fetch HSM certs and post a presigned bundle. Might need infra to redact serials.
security-bot: Auto: Added checklist item: "presign_ttl" set to 48h for partner review. Use `artifact-presign --ttl 48h` if you want shorter window.
sarah: Scheduling: partner reviewer available Tue 10:00 PT or Wed 15:00 PT. I can do Tue 10:00. Parth?
parth: Tue 10:00 PT works. Jenn and Mike able to join?
jenn: Tue 10:00 PT ok.
mike: I'll be there.
parth: Action items summary: sarah - redacted SOC + questionnaire answers + KMS screenshots; mike - presigned SAML metadata + HSM/FIPS cert bundle; jenn - pen-test exec summary + ticket list; lisa-legal - approve redaction list and cover email. We'll upload artifacts to s3 and share presigned links during the call.
security-bot: Auto: Slack reminder scheduled for 2026-03-10T09:45:00Z for the partner sync.
parth: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the cover note and tracker entry after uploads.
